title: Harvey Recovery - A Joint Effort (546776)
description:
Recovery is a joint effort! First responders helping victims of the epic flooding from Hurricane Harvey are joined by military units and other federal agencies from around the country. Here's a look at the impact they're making.

Video by Harry Lockley.
